$comment: Who may edit what: the single source for guard-edit-scope.ts (PreToolUse) and for
delegation.ts's brief and return checks. Globs are repo-relative: `dir/**` covers
everything under dir; other patterns match segment by segment (`*` within a segment).
Anything no agent owns belongs to the coordinator: CLAUDE.md, .claude/, docs/, config/,
and root config files (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, tsconfig.base.json, vitest.config.ts).
edit_scope_mode: `block` denies an out-of-scope edit; `warn` allows it and logs it.
